objective: Determine whether the pre-startup retained-default-graph recipe, inline per-candidate tensor fingerprinting, or their interaction changes natural default-versus-explicit selection or actual retained serving-graph replay, while keeping source and auto measurement fixed.

flashinfer_source.implementation: Exact original diff applied cleanly to0.7.2, not full PR head; candidate source only for every arm.
flashinfer_source.native_loading: Reuse audited prepare_native(candidate): explicit JitSpec.build/load, identical module bootstrap in every arm; reject AOT substitution. One isolated candidate build workspace, fresh process/container per worker.

environment.hardware_change: Request the same H100 NVL physical GPU; require identical UUID, driver and power limit before workers. Any necessary hardware substitution requires an explicitly recorded protocol revision before measurements. Comparisons are within this batch.

workload.projection: First transformer layer fused q/k/v projection, concatenated in source-verified SGLang QKV loader order.
workload.fixture: Frozen captured BF16 activations and checkpoint weights; per-tensor static scales calibrated from this one input/weight tensor. Exact shapes, tensor/file hashes and capture provenance frozen before tuning workers.
workload.measurement_policy: Unspecified current/auto in every cell; actual FP8 path eager/hot-L2 profiling. v2 default comparison enabled throughout.
workload.persistence: Winner consumption is memory-only inside matching replay scopes at capture. Existing wrapper may emit incidental v1 JSON, but workers never reload it and no explicit-policy persistence claim is made. Managed persistence disabled in both arms.
workload.shape_limit: One representative captured prefill projection, not full-model output accuracy or traffic distribution. Dense BF16 checkpoint adapted to static per-tensor FP8 for this experiment; no production calibration claim.
workload.path: Actual SGLang static quantizer, normal custom-op dispatch/fast path and allocation, FlashInfer cublas FP8 implementation; no replacement or output copy in timed calls.
workload.profiling_input_limit: Serving uses identical captured fixture bytes. The tuner retains its synthesized dynamic profiling activations. F1 records four-operand bytes immediately before each real profiler call; F0 records shape/stride/dtype only and retains no profiling-input references. F0 does not directly attest synthetic tensor-byte equality. Neither factor changes the candidate pool or RNG seed.

protocol.trial_order: Ascending0..7; four cells per trial in the exact schedule. Two full Williams four-row blocks. Source/plan frozen before first GPU worker. Fixed32 workers; no adaptive expansion or performance stopping.
protocol.counterbalance: Within each Williams block every cell occupies each launch slot once and every directed within-trial predecessor pair once. Across both blocks each cell-by-slot pair has one winner-first and one default-first capture. Between-trial device-history transitions are not perfectly balanced.

history_factor.h0: After identical common setup, omit extra pre-startup graph and its measurement.
history_factor.h1: After identical common setup, capture a true-default-miss graph, retain it through primary timings, and perform its original500ms warmup,20ms calibration,15-sample measurement before actual startup tuning.
history_factor.estimand_limit: Bundled pre-startup recipe includes capture, live allocations, GPU work and elapsed time; it does not isolate temperature, clocks or a pure tuning effect.

fingerprint_factor.f0: Keep profiler settings/counters/results/errors and operand metadata. Omit per-candidate GPU reads/copies/transfers/SHA; no retained synthetic tensor references.
fingerprint_factor.f1: Exact existing activation/weight/input-scale/weight-scale tensor-to-CPU SHA immediately before each original profiler call; output/workspace excluded.
fingerprint_factor.observer_limit: Outside profiler timestamps does not mean nonintervening; the noncontiguous4MiB weight copy, GPU-to-CPU transfers and SHA alter surrounding history. F0 has no direct synthetic-byte proof.

graphs.winner: Actual natural memory-hit winner captured after startup.
graphs.default: Independent graph of actual genuine cache-miss tactic-1; reversible full cache-state removal/restoration.
graphs.history: Only H1 owns an additional pre-startup default graph; not a primary timing comparator.

protocol.capture_order: Explicit per-worker schedule field, independently balanced from cell launch order. Winner/default output allocations remain distinct.
protocol.profiling_change: Only H/F experimental factors; no upstream preparation fix, current-main shift, policy, candidate-order, representative-input or persistence migration.
protocol.block_order: 12 winner/default and12 default/winner blocks, deterministic shuffle seed6100+trial, identical for four cells within a repetition.
protocol.timing: Actual retained serving graphs replay outside policy scopes; primary CUDA-event replay span and secondary wall span,5120calls per batch. No profiler/probe/lookup/subprocess inside spans. Events can include host enqueue gaps.
protocol.identity: Mandatory post-timing Torch profiler pass over the exact same retained winner/default objects in each timing worker, without recapture. Preserve per-graph labels and ordered kernel name/grid/block/register/shared signatures across3replays. Instrumented durations are diagnostic only.
protocol.numerical_guards: Actual graph-owned allocation, independent quantized-input FP32 reference, output poison, zero and restored captured input; dense BF16 approximation separately diagnostic.
protocol.checkpoint: First complete four-cell trial integrity gate before remaining28workers; no threshold on winner identity, margin or speedup.
protocol.startup_scope: Instrumented startup walltime is secondary and includes the selected fingerprint intervention; pre-startup history measurement has a separate interval.

acceptance: Exact frozen source/overlay/nativebuild/container/physicalGPU/fixture hashes verified; new upstream implementation excluded.
Every worker H/F/capture order matches preregistered32worker schedule; fresh containers and native binary identity across cohort.
Actual natural minimum selection and default-first participation preserved; candidate failures visible rather than silently excluded.
F1 actual profiling bytes attested; F0 metadata-only and no retained synthetic references, without fabricating absent hashes.
Actual memory winner hit/default miss/cache restoration/no post-startup profiling and outside-scope replay verified.
All graph-owned outputs pass numerical/poison/changed/restored-input checks; exact retained objects traced only after primary timing.
All valid outcomes preserved without performance threshold; first complete4worker gate covers integrity only.

analysis.independent_unit: Eight complete fresh-process four-cell repetitions. Profile candidates,24replay blocks,15sequential samples and3instrumented trace replays are dependent within-worker observations.
analysis.primary_selection: Runtime-bucket minimum best-explicit/default profiler ratio and signed percent margin, all finite/error rows, natural winner identity/count. Preserve continuous margins even if the categorical winner does not change.
analysis.primary_serving: For each worker median of same-block winner/default GPU-event ratios, actual kernel signatures and capture order. No assumption that public tactic-1 proves identical CUDA kernels.
analysis.factorial: Within each complete trial log contrasts: H=.5[(logR10+logR11)-(logR00+logR01)], F=.5[(logR01+logR11)-(logR00+logR10)], interaction=logR11-logR10-logR01+logR00. Apply separately to best-explicit/default profiling ratio and selected/default serving ratio; exponentiate and report all8values.
analysis.uncertainty: Exploratory95percent percentile bootstrap of the median trial contrast, resampling complete four-cell trial vectors only. Exact multinomial weights represent all8^8 ordered resamples compactly; checkpoints with n1 report no CI. No block/sample pooling, multiple-testing significance or adaptive expansion.
analysis.descriptive: Per-cell winner frequencies/tactics, profile margins, rawlatencies, startup time, capture-order strata and recorded device snapshots. Preserve neutral/slower outcomes. Physical launch equality does not imply equal address mapping/cache/device state.
analysis.exclusions: No candidate-time trimming or removal of surprising valid trials. Invalid worker/trace/source/cache/numeric evidence fails integrity with exact reason and preserved attempt; coordinator retries require recorded justification.
analysis.scope_limits: Single static-calibrated FP8 QKV fixture/H100/backend/hot-buffer source; no fullmodel accuracy/throughput, TP/EP, decode matrix, persistence or managed-store claim.

publication.private_material: Fixture tensors, native binaries and internal host details remain in private raw archive; public evidence keeps allowed hashes/metadata and filtered raw logs.

resource_policy: One exclusive same-GPU allocation; root freezes the exact source and confirms bounded allocation duration before launch. Preserve every attempt, exact binary/fixture private archive and node/durable/download hashes. No CI trigger or PR.
